statement: Partner (broker) booking flow: we send Booking Confirmation (payment terms and bank details, booking confirmation number used as payment reference), Charter Party (signed copy to be returned) and Boarding Pass (yacht info plus crew list link). Deposit receipt is confirmed by us by email, and the next payment date is stated (example: deposit 14 Nov 2025, next payment 20 Nov 2025, balance paid Jul 2026). Payments are confirmed with 'Payment received with thanks.'

Deposit confirmation for a broker booking (Pulsar, Dufour 460GL, 26.09-03.10.2026): once the first payment is received in our account we confirm the booking; the next payment was scheduled for 01.08.2026. Commission paid to the broker after the charter and paid by bank transfer; bank slip sent to broker 11.10.2026.

Broker flow (Scoala de Vele / Embark Evolution): broker sends skipper ID and the bookings from the booking system (client booking and agency booking), client pays us directly, broker issues commission invoice after the second payment. We confirm the booking once the deposit is received in our account, then remind the next payment date. Broker also sends crew list form and skipper permit.
